title: Codemod across 60 handler files
notes: Scores take the strongest file, never a sum, so 60 two-line edits under the broad src/** glob stay at 0.6 x 0.67 = 0.40 for the overview page (no alert). The logging page anchors src/handlers/** and quotes the removed import and log.info, so the identifier and snippet boosts flag it.

pages.title: Payments API overview
pages.storage:
The service exposes three endpoints:

  • GET /healthz

  • POST /v1/charges

  • POST /v1/refunds

Routes are registered in src/server.ts. Handlers live under src/handlers/.

pages.title: Logging conventions
pages.storage:
